unresolved.reason: The current Panamanian Embassy schedule does not name Macao SAR in its no-visa, authorised-visa or stamped-visa ordinary visitor cohorts. Its country-selector data is not a visa classification, and the named cohorts are not stated as an all-other-passports complement. No direct Macao issuer source establishes actual Panama issuance timing.

The current Panamanian Embassy schedule does not name Timor-Leste in its no-visa, authorised-visa or stamped-visa ordinary visitor cohorts. Those named cohorts are not stated as an all-other-passports complement, and no direct Timorese issuer source establishes actual Panama issuance timing.

The current Panamanian Embassy schedule names Sudan in the authorised-visa cohort but does not name the distinct State of South Sudan in any ordinary visitor cohort. The separate Foreign Ministry authorised-visa process cannot bridge that nationality gap, and the named lists are not an all-other-passports complement.
